method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

verification_summary.limitation: Selected source access and manually adjudicated record-level passages are listed separately. Verification applies only to individually listed claims; all remaining evidence/pathways and the country bank as a whole remain unresolved-limited.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 152, section 3: sustainable water resources

evidence.scenario: The communication does not specify a climate scenario.
evidence.compact_statement: The 2019 communication anticipates climate pressure on water and describes competing control/use among water managers, recommending basin coordination. The passage concerns administrative resource governance, not documented armed conflict.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2019 reports: The report says the absence of a national meteorological system prevents services for agriculture, fishing and water management, including early warnings for floods and dangerous weather.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-06 reports: The NDC relies on only two ASECNA stations, in Malabo and Bata; cited trends show significantly rising temperatures in Malabo but a different pattern in Bata, with no significant accumulated-rainfall trend.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF p.18, vulnerability and reported climate changes.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-06 reports: Citing the 2013 adaptation plan, the NDC reports that residents had noted more storms and floods, drying springs and warmer conditions; it labels the country highly vulnerable.
